story.body: You handed over the sealed letter and took Anne's, and the parcel. You read the sheet in the yard and again at the window. You did not open the parcel.

story.body: You kept her line on the Michaelmas money, when it falls and not before, and you kept the ladder of rope. You did not open the parcel.
